title: Classroom or lab space with projection screens and seated attendees
objects_and_counts: At least 12 people are visible seated or standing in the photographed scene; some are turned away from the camera and a few are partially obscured by tables (visible minimum count is 12).
Two large projection screens are visible at the front of the room showing presentation slides (one at centre-left, one at centre-right).
At least two ceiling-mounted projectors are visible (one roughly centre, one left-of-centre); a dome ceiling camera is visible near the top-right of the image.

Six high work tables with light-coloured wooden tops and metal frames are clearly visible in the foreground and middle of the room (three near the front row, three in middle/back rows); additional tables extend further back but exact total is not determinable from this crop.
Numerous high stools are visible around the tables; at least 14 distinct stools can be individually seen, with many others partially obscured so an exact total cannot be determined.
A freestanding poster/display board on a table at the right-front of the scene is visible with printed panels and images mounted on it.

Laptop computers are present on at least two tables near the front where presenters or facilitators are seated; additional small electronic devices (phone, chargers, cables) are visible but not precisely countable.
A small white plastic basket containing components or cables is on the right-front table beneath the poster.

Large windows run along the far side wall behind the presenters, providing natural light from that side of the room.

A freestanding poster/display board sits on the right-front table near the camera viewpoint and is oriented to face into the room.
